papers.title_en: Effects and Moderators of High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT) on Physiological Adaptations Among Team-Sport Athletes: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
papers.title_zh: 高强度间歇训练（HIIT）对团队运动运动员生理适应的影响及调节因素：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
papers.journal: Scandinavian Journal of Medicine and Science in Sports
papers.tldr_en: Overall, adding HIIT to regular sport-specific training improves aerobic and anaerobic performance in trained team-sport athletes, whereas effects on body composition are limited.
papers.abstract_en: High-intensity interval training (HIIT) is widely used in team sports, but the influence of participant and programme characteristics on physiological adaptations remains unclear. Five databases (Web of Science Core Collection, PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and CNKI) were searched initially on 25 April 2025 and updated on 21 December 2025. Mixed-effects models were used to estimate Hedges' g and 95% confidence intervals (CI). Forty-six studies involving 1204 athletes were included. papers.abstract_zh: 高强度间歇训练（HIIT）在团队运动中被广泛应用，但参与者和训练方案特征对生理适应的影响尚不明确。本研究于2025年4月25日首次检索并于2025年12月21日更新了五个数据库（Web of Science核心合集、PubMed、Embase、Scopus和CNKI）。采用混合效应模型估计Hedges' g和95%置信区间（CI）。共纳入46项研究，涉及1204名运动员。与单独的常规专项训练相比，HIIT对最大摄氧量（VO2max；g）产生了积极影响。

papers.title_en: Clinical applications of wearable sensor-based gait analysis in athletes: a systematic review for injury prevention and rehabilitation
papers.title_zh: 基于可穿戴传感器步态分析在运动员中的临床应用：一项用于损伤预防和康复的系统综述
papers.journal: BMC Sports Science Medicine and Rehabilitation
papers.journal_tier: 康复医学2区/运动科学3区
papers.tldr_en: Evaluating the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes, examining its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and identifying methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration identifies key challenges.
papers.abstract_en: Gait analysis is fundamental for optimizing athletic performance and mitigating injury risks in sports medicine. While traditional laboratory assessments offer insights, the emergence of wearable sensor technology provides novel opportunities for objective, real-time gait evaluation in ecologically valid settings. This systematic review aims to (1) evaluate the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes (2), examine its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and (3) identify methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration. Adhering to PRISMA 2020 guidelines, a systematic search was conducted across MEDLINE, Web of Science, Scopus, and Embase from inception to May 31st, 2025. papers.abstract_zh: 步态分析对于优化运动表现和降低运动医学中的损伤风险至关重要。尽管传统的实验室评估提供了见解，但可穿戴传感器技术的出现为在生态学有效环境下进行客观、实时的步态评估提供了新的机会。本系统综述旨在（1）评估基于可穿戴传感器的步态分析在运动员损伤预防中的临床疗效，（2）考察其在康复监测和临床决策中的作用，以及（3）识别方法学局限性和未来的研究方向。

papers.title_en: Building for the Future: A Systematic Review of the Effects of Eccentric Resistance Training on Measures of Physical Performance in Youth Athletes
papers.title_zh: 为未来而建：一项关于离心阻力训练对青少年运动员身体表现测量影响的系统综述
papers.tldr_en: The findings of this systematic review support the inclusion of eccentric resistance training in youth athletes to improve measures of muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction performance.
papers.abstract_en: Background Eccentric resistance training is recognised as an effective stimulus for enhancing measures of muscular strength and power in adult populations; however, its value in youth athletes is currently not well understood. Objective The aim of this systematic review was to critically appraise the effects of eccentric resistance training on measures of physical performance (i.e. muscular strength, jump, sprint and change of direction) in youth athletes 18 years of age and under. Methods Original journal articles published between 1950 and June 2022 were retrieved from electronic search engines of PubMed, SPORTDiscus and Google Scholar’s advanced search option. Full journal articles investigating the acute and chronic effects of eccentric resistance training on measures of physical performance in youth athletes (i.e. a person 18 years of age or under who competes in sport) were include
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 离心阻力训练被认为是提高成年人肌肉力量和爆发力的有效刺激；然而，其在青少年运动员中的价值目前尚未被充分理解。目的 本系统综述旨在批判性评估离心阻力训练对18岁及以下青少年运动员身体表现（即肌肉力量、跳跃、冲刺和变向能力）测量指标的影响。方法 检索了1950年至2022年6月期间发表的原始期刊文章。

papers.title_en: Effects of different dietary supplements combined with conditioning training on muscle strength, jump performance, sprint speed, and muscle mass in athletes: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
papers.title_zh: 不同膳食补充剂结合体能训练对运动员肌肉力量、跳跃表现、冲刺速度和肌肉量的影响：一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析
papers.tldr_en: Protein supplementation appears to be the most effective strategy for increasing muscular strength; β-alanine and creatine both improve jump performance, with β-alanine offering marginally superior effectiveness; and creatine is particularly beneficial for sprint speed.
papers.abstract_en: Background As dietary supplements have become integral to meeting athletes’ specialised nutritional requirements, research into their effects on performance has intensified. Yet inconsistent findings leave the efficacy of some supplements—most notably branched-chain amino acids and β-hydroxy-β-methylbutyrate (HMB)—open to debate. To clarify which products offer the greatest benefit, we undertook a systematic review and network meta-analysis aimed at identifying the supplements most effective for athletes, including protein, creatine, β-alanine, HMB, vitamin D, caffeine, and others. Methods PubMed, Web of Science, the Cochrane Library, Embase and SPORTDiscus were searched from database inception to 15 March 2024 for RCTs evaluating the effects of dietary supplements (including but not limited to protein, creatine, β-alanine, HMB, caffeine, and vitamin D) on athletic performance. papers.abstract_zh: 背景 随着膳食补充剂成为满足运动员特殊营养需求不可或缺的一部分，对其性能影响的研究也日益增多。然而，不一致的发现使得一些补充剂（尤其是支链氨基酸和β-羟基-β-甲基丁酸（HMB））的功效仍存在争议。为了明确哪些产品能带来最大益处，我们进行了一项系统综述和网络荟萃分析，旨在确定对运动员最有效的补充剂，包括蛋白质、肌酸、β-丙氨酸、HMB、维生素D、咖啡因等。方法 检索了已发表的文献。

papers.title_en: AI-driven medical image analysis for sports injury diagnosis and prevention
papers.title_zh: 人工智能驱动的医学图像分析用于运动损伤诊断与预防
papers.tldr_en: An AI-driven framework integrating deep learning, biomechanical modeling, and adaptive decision-making for injury prediction and rehabilitation optimization is proposed, paving the way for more accurate, interpretable, and responsive injury management systems.
papers.abstract_en: Sports-related injuries present significant challenges in diagnosis, prevention, and rehabilitation, often requiring precise assessments across multiple imaging modalities. Traditional diagnostic approaches rely on manual interpretation, which is time-consuming and prone to variability. To address these limitations, we propose an AI-driven framework integrating deep learning, biomechanical modeling, and adaptive decision-making for injury prediction and rehabilitation optimization. The Biomechanically-Informed Neural Network (BINN) fuses kinematic, physiological, and performance data using attention mechanisms, enhancing both interpretability and predictive accuracy. BINN processes motion capture data through convolutional and recurrent layers, extracting meaningful biomechanical patterns to assess movement efficiency and injury risk. The Adaptive Sports Medicine Strategy (ASMS) dynamica
papers.abstract_zh: 运动相关损伤在诊断、预防和康复方面带来了重大挑战，通常需要在多种成像模式下进行精确评估。传统的诊断方法依赖于人工判读，这既耗时又容易出现变异性。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种人工智能驱动的框架，该框架整合了深度学习、生物力学建模和自适应决策，以实现损伤预测和康复优化。生物力学信息神经网络（BINN）利用注意力机制融合了运动学、生理学和表现数据。

papers.title_en: Nutritional Strategies in the Rehabilitation of Musculoskeletal Injuries in Athletes: A Systematic Integrative Review
papers.title_zh: 运动员肌肉骨骼损伤康复中的营养策略：一项系统整合性综述
papers.tldr_en: Based on the main findings of the selected studies, nutritional strategies that benefit the rehabilitation process in injured athletes include balanced energy intake, and a high-protein and carbohydrate-rich diet.
papers.abstract_en: It is estimated that three to five million sports injuries occur worldwide each year. The highest incidence is reported during competition periods with mainly affectation of the musculoskeletal tissue. For appropriate nutritional management and correct use of nutritional supplements, it is important to individualize based on clinical effects and know the adaptive response during the rehabilitation phase after a sports injury in athletes. Therefore, the aim of this PRISMA in Exercise, Rehabilitation, Sport Medicine and Sports Science PERSiST-based systematic integrative review was to perform an update on nutritional strategies during the rehabilitation phase of musculoskeletal injuries in elite athletes. After searching the following databases: PubMed/Medline, Scopus, PEDro, and Google Scholar, a total of 18 studies met the inclusion criteria (Price Index: 66.6%). The risk of bias assessm
papers.abstract_zh: 据估计，全球每年发生三到五百万例运动损伤。发病率最高的是比赛期间，主要影响肌肉骨骼组织。为了进行适当的营养管理和正确使用营养补充剂，重要的是根据临床效果进行个体化调整，并了解运动员运动损伤后康复阶段的适应性反应。因此，这项基于PRISMA for Exercise, Rehabilitation, Sport Medicine and Sports Science (PERSiST) 的系统整合性综述旨在进行一项全面的评估。
